tagShapeMismatches.english: The rivals are members of a thieves' guild from a neighboring city. They seek {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} for Skandor Torreth (neutral, human {@creature assassin}), a guildmaster who needs information only the portrait knows.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 對手是來自鄰近城市的盜賊公會的成員。他們為斯坎多·託雷思（中立，人類{@creature 刺客}），一個需要只有畫像才知道的資訊的公會首領，尋找{@item 康斯坦托里的肖像畫|KftGV}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Audible {@spell alarm} spells have been cast in areas marked (A) on {@adventure map 1.2|KftGV|1|MAP 1.2: DM'S MAP}. The museum's guards and the curator have pass cards that allow them to bypass these alarms, and spare pass cards are kept in {@area area V7|04d|x} (see "{@area Bypassing Alarms|029|x}" below for more information). The alarms are located as follows:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在{@adventure 地圖 1.2|KftGV|1|地圖 1.2: 地下城主的地圖}上標記為(A)的區域，已經施放了可聽見的{@spell 警報術}法術。博物館的警衛和館長持有通行證卡片，允許他們繞過這些警報，備用的通行證卡片存放在{@area 區域V7|04d|x}（詳見下文"繞過警報{@area 繞過警報|029|x}"以獲取更多資訊）。警報的位置如下：

tagShapeMismatches.english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell 警報術}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell 警報術}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell 警報術}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When Cirque Maladomini isn't performing in area A8, the northwest cage holds three trained {@creature Baboon||baboons} that shriek whenever someone new enters the room, and the northeast cage contains a quiet trained {@creature lion} named Emrys. Three tiefling acrobats ({@creature Commoner||commoners} with {@skill Acrobatics} +4 and {@skill Performance} +4) are also rehearsing together in the middle of the room. One tiefling performs a one-handed handstand, while another twirls a flaming hoop, and the third plucks a banjo. During performances, the tieflings and the animals are all absent.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當馬拉多米尼馬戲團不在A8區域表演時，西北邊的籠子裡關著三隻受過訓練的{@creature 狒狒||狒狒}，每當有人新進入房間時就會尖叫，而東北邊的籠子裡則有一隻名叫埃姆里斯的安靜受過訓練的{@creature 獅子}。三名提夫林雜技演員（具有{@skill 特技} +4和{@skill 表演} +4的{@creature 平民||平民}）也在房間中央一起排練。其中一個提夫林表演單手倒立，另一個旋轉著火環，第三個彈奏班卓琴。在表演期間，提夫林和動物都不在場。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} is a chaotic good {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} who speaks Common, Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon. His Innate Spellcasting trait includes the ability to cast {@spell meld into stone} three times per day. He wears a gray robe instead of armor (AC 12) and carries a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell magic weapon} and a {@item Potion of Hill Giant Strength||potion of giant strength (hill)}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 卡沃達|KftGV} 是一個混亂善良的{@creature 地底侏儒（斯涅布力）||地底侏儒}，會說通用語、侏儒語、地語和下界語。他的天生施法能力包括每天三次施放{@spell 融身入石}的能力。他穿著灰色長袍而不是盔甲（AC 12），攜帶著一個{@spell 魔化武器}的{@item 法術卷軸}和一瓶{@item 山丘巨人之力藥水||巨人之力藥水（丘陵）}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The presence of intruders confuses, disturbs, and annoys Tockworth. If she is confronted by the characters here or if the {@spell alarm} spell triggers on the safe in {@area area L9b|1d3|x}, she casts {@spell dimension door} and steps through the spell's magical doorway into area L9b. As she leaves, she says, "Break time's over, Poots!" (The characters have no way to know this, but Poots is the name of an imaginary friend Tockworth invented in her childhood. This long-lost imaginary friend has resurfaced recently in response to Tockworth's mounting loneliness.)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 入侵者的出現讓托克沃斯感到困惑、不安和惱怒。如果她在這裡被角色們對峙，或者在{@area 區域L9b|1d3|x}區域的保險箱上的{@spell 警報術}法術被觸發，她會施放{@spell 任意門}並穿過法術的魔法門進入L9b區域。當她離開時，她說：'休息時間結束，普茨！'（角色們無法知道這一點，但普茨是托克沃斯童年時發明的想象中的朋友的名字。這個長久失蹤的想象中的朋友最近因托克沃斯日益增長的孤獨感而重新出現。）

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters can use {@spell invisibility} spells to approach and observe the guildhouse without being seen. They can also use a {@spell locate object} spell to pinpoint the painting's location ({@area area G27|260|x} on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}). If they don't have access to such magic, they can request Adrisa's help. Within a day, she can obtain a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell locate object} for them.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以使用{@spell 隱形術}法術來接近並觀察公會館而不被看到。他們還可以使用{@spell 物件定位術}法術來精確定位畫像的位置（在{@area 區域G27|260|x}上，見{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|地圖 6.2: 地下城主地圖}）。如果他們沒有接觸到這樣的魔法，他們可以請求阿德莉莎的幫助。在一天之內，她可以為他們獲得一張{@spell 物件定位術}法術的{@item 法術卷軸}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 18 or higher notices a conjuration rune peeking from under the rug. After discovering it, a character can use an action to try to disable the rune, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check or a {@spell dispel magic} spell.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被動感知（{@skill 察覺}）分數為18或更高的角色會注意到地毯下隱約可見的召喚符文。發現後，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試禁制該符文，需成功透過一個智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定（{@dc 18}）或使用一個{@spell 解除魔法}法術。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character can disable a particular rune (and its linked {@spell alarm} spell) with the {@spell dispel magic} spell or a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. A character who fails the check by 5 or more triggers the alarm. The first time a character successfully disables one of these runes, the DC to do so on the others decreases to 13. Alternatively, a character can slip an item out of its case without triggering the display case alarm by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. On a failed check, the audible alarm activates (see "Caught in the Act").
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個角色可以使用{@spell 解除魔法}法術或成功透過{@dc 18}智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定來禁用特定的符文（及其關聯的{@spell 警報術}法術）。如果角色在檢定中失敗且差值達到5或更多，警報將被觸發。當一個角色首次成功禁用了其中一個符文後，禁用其他符文的DC將降低到13。另外，角色可以透過成功進行{@dc 18}敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定，在未觸發展示櫃警報的情況下將物品從展示櫃中取出。如果檢定失敗，可聽見的警報將被啟用（見"當場抓獲"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters attempt to place the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} in the heart without {@creature Rilago|KftGV}, the shard falls out again and nothing happens. A character who observes this and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check realizes a mystical force shattered the giant's heart and that this same force might be able to mend it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色嘗試在沒有 {@creature 里拉戈|KftGV} 的情況下將 {@item 澤巒碎片|KftGV} 放入心臟中，碎片會再次掉出，且不會發生任何事。觀察到此情況併成功透過 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定的角色會意識到一種神秘力量摧毀了巨人的心臟，而這種力量或許也能修復它。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Aminta is meeting with two of her distribution generals ({@creature Veteran||veterans}). Edino (the elf {@creature mage} from {@area area X10|399|x}) and the two {@creature Doppelganger||doppelgangers} from {@area area X15|3a8|x} might be here as well.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 阿明塔正在與她的兩位分銷將軍（{@creature 老兵||老兵}）會面。來自{@area 區域X10|399|x}的精靈{@creature 魔法師}埃迪諾，以及來自{@area 區域X15|3a8|x}的兩個{@creature 變形怪||變形怪}可能也在這裡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: "I delivered a {@item flame tongue longsword} to {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}, who then bequeathed it to his most loyal captain, Naevys, as thanks for her years of faithful service. Charmayne was furious that Jhaeros wasted coin on a sword for Naevys, but then, she was always distracted by one petty jealousy or another."
tagShapeMismatches.translated: "我向 {@creature 國王賈埃羅斯|KftGV} 交付了一把 {@item 焰舌長劍}，然後他將其贈予了他最忠誠的隊長 納維斯，以感謝她多年的忠誠服務。夏梅恩 對 賈埃羅斯 浪費金錢為 納維斯 買劍感到非常憤怒，但話說回來，她總是被這樣或那樣的小嫉妒所分心。"

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@b Ethlynn Stalaczic} (neutral, drow {@creature mage}) is a friendly, somewhat gullible dragonologist on a planar quest to find a "time dragon" (which may or may not be a real thing). Until a few moments ago, Ethlynn and Quintus were cabin mates. Ethlynn currently shares her cabin (the one marked "b" on {@area map 11.2|422|x}) with a {@creature monodrone} valet called Bot.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@b 埃瑟琳·斯塔拉奇克}（中立，黑暗精靈{@creature 魔法師})是一個友好的、有點輕信的龍學家，她正在進行一次尋找"時間龍"（可能存在也可能不存在的東西）的位面任務。直到幾分鐘前，埃瑟琳和昆圖斯還是室友。埃瑟琳目前與一個名叫博特的{@creature 單元冢}男僕共享她的隔間（在{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}上標記為'b'）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@b Meldar} (lawful neutral {@creature azer}) is indifferent toward others, speaks nothing but Ignan, and provides curt answers to questions put to them. The azer is returning to the City of Brass after attending a smiths' convention in Bytopia. Meldar shares a cabin (the one marked "c" on {@area map 11.2|422|x}) with {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV} and a monodrone valet known as Orb.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@b 梅爾達爾}（守序中立的{@creature azer||火矮人}）對他人漠不關心，只會說火族語，並且對提出的問題會給出簡短的回答。這位火矮人在雙生天堂參加完一場鐵匠大會後，正返回黃銅城。梅爾達爾與{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}以及一位名為奧布的單元冢僕從共住一間小屋（在{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}中標有"c"的房間）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The slaad works for an evil, multiverse-spanning organization called the Syndicate of Terror, Extortion, Assassination, and Larceny (STEAL), which has been spying on the characters for some time and wants their mission aboard the Concordant Express to fail. (This is doubly true if the characters are working for STEAL's rival, the Golden Vault.) If you're weaving multiple adventures from this anthology into your campaign, one or more villains from earlier adventures might have secret ties to this evil organization. Likely candidates (assuming they're still alive) include Quentin Togglepocket from "{@adventure The Stygian Gambit|KftGV|2}," Guildmaster Dusk from "{@adventure Masterpiece Imbroglio|KftGV|6}," and {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV} from "{@adventure Vidorant's Vault|KftGV|8}." If you're using the rivals described in this book's {@area introduction|00c|x}, their patron might be a STEAL operative.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個史拉蟾為名為恐怖、敲詐、刺殺與盜竊聯合會（STEAL）的邪惡組織效力，該組織跨越多元宇宙，已經暗中監視了角色們一段時間，並希望他們在協和快車上的任務失敗。（如果角色們為STEAL的競爭對手金庫工作，這一點就更加成立。）如果你將這本選集中的多個冒險編織到你的戰役中，早期冒險中的一個或多個反派可能與這個邪惡組織有秘密聯絡。可能的候選人（假設他們還活著）包括來自"{@adventure 冥河的謀略|KftGV|2}"的昆汀·託格波克，來自"{@adventure 傑作糾葛|KftGV|6}"的公會大師達斯克，以及來自"{@adventure 維多蘭特的金庫|KftGV|8}"的{@creature 尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特|KftGV}。如果你使用的是本書{@area 簡介|00c|x}中描述的對手，他們的庇護人可能是STEAL的特工。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As an action, a character can try to steal the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, or a character can use a {@spell suggestion} spell or similar magic to try to make the simulacrum relinquish the necklace. (Even though the simulacrum is a Construct, it can be {@condition charmed}.) The simulacrum becomes hostile toward anyone who tries to take the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. The simulacrum doesn't care about collateral damage to Paliset Hall, its staff, or its guests.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試透過一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定來偷取{@item 破碎孤石（鑽石）|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊，或者角色可以使用{@spell 暗示術}法術或類似的魔法來嘗試使擬像交出項鍊。（儘管擬像是一個構裝體，它仍然可以被{@condition 魅惑}。）擬像會對任何試圖拿走{@item 破碎孤石（鑽石）|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的人變得敵對。擬像並不在意對帕利塞特莊園、其員工或客人造成的附帶傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@dice 1d8} hours after the characters return to the Material Plane with the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} in their possession
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們帶著{@item 破碎孤石（鑽石）|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}返回物質位面後的{@dice 1d8}小時

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any fights or suspicious activities in the hold are reported to the {@creature efreeti} {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}, who places the defenders on high alert. Even if Vrakir is at the hold, the defenders bring their reports to {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} first, allowing him to deal with any trouble himself rather than risk Vrakir's ire. While on high alert, the hold's inhabitants can't be surprised, and {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} responds personally to any further reports of trouble, arriving after 1 minute with two {@creature Salamander||salamanders} from {@area area B20|50d|x}. After 24 hours with no incidents, the hold goes off high alert.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 堡內任何打鬥或可疑活動都會被報告給{@creature 火巨靈} {@creature 賈拉尊|KftGV}，他會將守衛置於高度警戒狀態。即使弗拉基爾在堡內，守衛們也會先將報告交給{@creature 賈拉尊|KftGV}，讓他自己處理任何麻煩，而不是冒險激怒弗拉基爾。在高度警戒狀態下，堡的居民不會被突襲，而且{@creature 賈拉尊|KftGV}會親自響應任何進一步的麻煩報告，1分鐘後帶著兩隻來自{@area 區域B20|50d|x}的{@creature 火蜥蜴||火蜥蜴們}到達。如果沒有發生任何事件，24小時後堡將解除高度警戒狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When the hold is on high alert, a third {@creature erinyes} from {@area area B15|501|x} takes up position in the gatehouse's rear tower.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當堡處於高度警戒狀態時，來自{@area 區域B15|501|x}的第三名{@creature 罪魔}會佔據門房的後塔樓位置。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@item Book of Vile Darkness} is so blasphemous that its mere presence erodes the demiplane Vrakir made to contain it. Review the {@item book of vile darkness||artifact's description} in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, then replace its Random Properties with the following preset ones:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@item Book of Vile Darkness||穢暗之書}是如此褻瀆神明的存在，以至於僅僅其存在就會腐蝕弗拉基爾為封存它而創造的半位面。請在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中查閱{@item book of vile darkness||神器的描述}，然後以以下預設屬性取代其「隨機屬性」：

numericDifferences.english: The northernmost chamber is where patrons receive therapeutic massages (10 gp for an hour) or relax in the wood-sided sauna for free. A locked double door in the east wall leads to the laundry (area A7).
numericDifferences.localized: 最北邊的房間是顧客接受治療性按摩（1小時10金幣）或免費在木製桑拿中放鬆的地方。東牆上的一扇鎖著的雙門通向洗衣房（區域 A7）。

numericDifferences.english: The vault is forty feet deep and almost twice as wide. A security mirror stares back at you from the far wall. Seven treasure chests rest on low tables positioned against the north and east walls, and two tall wardrobes stand against the south wall.
numericDifferences.localized: 金庫深40尺，寬度幾乎是深度的兩倍。一面安全鏡從遠牆反射回你的視線。七個寶箱放在靠北牆和東牆的低桌上，兩個高大的衣櫃立在南牆邊。

numericDifferences.english: An inventor named Ignus Flint (lawful neutral, deep gnome {@creature mage} who speaks Common, Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon) built the contraption and recently locked himself inside it with enough food and water to keep himself alive for 1 week. A metal hatch at the back of the vehicle is the only entrance, and Ignus used a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell arcane lock} to seal it. A character can use an action to try to pull open the magically sealed hatch, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the characters knock on the contraption, they hear Ignus's muffled voice shout, "Go away!" in Gnomish. Ignus attacks anyone who breaks into his contraption but surrenders if reduced to 10 hit points or fewer.
numericDifferences.localized: 一位名叫伊格納斯·弗林特（守序中立，深侏儒 {@creature mage||魔法師}，會說通用語、侏儒語、土族語和地底通用語）的發明家建造了這個裝置，最近他把自己鎖在裡面，並且配備了足夠維持一週的食物和水。車輛後部的一個金屬艙口是唯一的入口，伊格納斯使用了一張 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 的 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 來封住它。角色可以使用一個動作嘗試拉開這個魔法密封的艙口，成功透過 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。如果角色敲擊這個裝置，他們會聽到伊格納斯模糊的聲音用侏儒語大喊："走開！"。伊格納斯會攻擊任何闖入他裝置的人，但如果生命值降至10點或以下，他會投降。

numericDifferences.english: Breakfast is served in the dining hall ({@area area C1|2b6|x}) on level 1.
numericDifferences.localized: 早餐在一樓的餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）供應。

numericDifferences.english: Sythian supervises rehearsals in the music hall ({@area area C11|2cb|x}) on level 3 while the servants work and Joster lazes about.
numericDifferences.localized: 西提安在三樓的音樂廳（{@area 區域C11|2cb|x}）監督排練，而僕人們工作，喬斯特則閒逛。

numericDifferences.english: A courier drops off Sythian's mail, which he reads in his study ({@area area C14|2d3|x}) on level 3, with Joster present, while the students relax in the gallery ({@area area C4|2bf|x}) on level 1.
numericDifferences.localized: 一名信使送來了西提安的郵件，他在三樓的書房（{@area 區域C14|2d3|x}）閱讀郵件，喬斯特在場，而學生們在一樓的畫廊（{@area 區域C4|2bf|x}）放鬆。

numericDifferences.english: The students practice their music unsupervised, either in their quarters ({@area area C7|2c5|x}) on level 2 or in the music hall ({@area area C11|2cb|x}). Sythian writes letters in his study ({@area area C14|2d3|x}) or prays in the shrine ({@area area C5|2c1|x}) on level 1, usually with Joster present.
numericDifferences.localized: 學生們在無人監督的情況下練習音樂，要麼在他們在二樓的房間（{@area 區域C7|2c5|x}），要麼在音樂廳（{@area 區域C11|2cb|x}）。西提安在他的書房（{@area 區域C14|2d3|x}）寫信，或者在一樓的神龕（{@area 區域C5|2c1|x}）祈禱，通常喬斯特在場。

numericDifferences.english: Sythian, Joster, and the students retire to their quarters (Joster and the students in {@area area C7|2c5|x} on level 2, Sythian in {@area area C15|2d6|x} on level 3) while the servants tidy up.
numericDifferences.localized: 西提安、喬斯特和學生們退回到他們的房間（喬斯特和學生們在二樓的{@area 區域C7|2c5|x}，西提安在三樓的{@area 區域C15|2d6|x}），而僕人們在打掃。

numericDifferences.english: A 5-foot-wide cage elevator fitted with stained-glass windows connects the dining hall on level 1 ({@area area C1|2b6|x}) to the mezzanine on level 2 ({@area area C6|2c3|x}) and the hallway on level 3 ({@area area C13|2d0|x}). The elevator is powered by magic. A creature in the elevator need only say "level 1," "level 2," or "level 3" in Common, and the elevator will ascend or descend to that floor, clattering noisily and taking about 6 seconds to move from one floor to the next. The elevator doesn't respond to commands while it is moving.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個5尺寬的籠子電梯，配備了彩色玻璃窗，連線了一樓的餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）到二樓的夾層（{@area 區域C6|2c3|x}）和三樓的走廊（{@area 區域C13|2d0|x}）。電梯由魔法驅動。電梯內的生物只需用通用語說出"一樓"、"二樓"或"三樓"，電梯就會上升或下降到相應樓層，嘈雜地響動並在大約6秒內從一個樓層移動到另一個樓層。電梯在移動時不響應命令。

numericDifferences.english: The four shelves each hold eight potions in vials (see "Treasure" below). Any character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 18 or higher notices the shelves are precariously balanced. To safely remove a potion from a shelf, someone must steady the shelf with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check or the shelf collapses, shattering all the potion vials on it. Each creature within 5 feet of a collapsing shelf must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@dice 5d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The noise alerts the guards in the lobby ({@area area T1|307|x}), who arrive 2 rounds later to investigate.
numericDifferences.localized: 四個架子上每個都放著八瓶藥劑（見下方的"寶藏"部分）。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值為18或更高的角色會注意到這些架子非常不穩固。要安全地從架子上取下一瓶藥劑，必須成功透過{@dc 12}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來穩住架子，否則架子會倒塌，摔碎上面的所有藥劑瓶。在倒塌架子5尺範圍內的每個生物都必須進行{@dc 12}敏捷豁免檢定，若檢定失敗則受到17點（{@dice 5d6}）酸蝕傷害，檢定成功則僅受到一半傷害。噪音會提醒大廳（{@area 區域T1|307|x}）的守衛，他們會在兩輪後趕到調查。

numericDifferences.english: On the second floor's large balcony, a table and chairs allow for dining while enjoying a lovely view of the city. The view is unimpeded by a low railing. To the east, a rope ladder hangs from the balcony to the ground fifteen feet below. A double door leads into the building.
numericDifferences.localized: 在二樓的大陽臺上，桌子和椅子讓人可以在享受城市美景的同時用餐。低矮的欄杆並沒有阻礙視線。向東望去，一條繩梯從陽臺垂下，直到下方15尺的地面。一對雙開門通向建築物內部。
